item.title: Domestic violence, strangulation lead to prison term - Port Townsend & Jefferson County Leader
item.description: Pedro Francisco Munoz-Renteria, pled guilty to felony charges of domestic violence, assault, unlawful imprisonment and criminal impersonation, and was sentenced March 13 in Jefferson County Superior Court to 29 months in custody followed by 18 months of probation, according to the Jefferson County Prosecutor’s Office. item.title: Gatheringplace receives $475,000 appropriation for new facility - Port Townsend & Jefferson County Leader
item.description: A years-long effort to build a permanent home for Gatheringplace Port Townsend just received a boost, with the Port Townsend nonprofit securing a $475,000 appropriation in the state’s supplemental capital budget. item.title: Whale of a time - Port Townsend & Jefferson County Leader
item.description: Two orcas, part of a newly arrived trio, breach alongside a container vessel in Admiralty Inlet on March 14. These rarely seen killer whales, designated T419, T420 and T421 were observed just off Point Wilson and Marrowstone Island, in the company of some of the region’s well-known Bigg’s (transient) killer whales.
